lab.samplingTitle: How to Collect & Ship Feed Samples to an Accredited Lab:
lab.samplingStep1: Sampling (Quartering Method): Draw ~500g composite sample from 4 to 5 different depths/spots of the batch or pit face.
lab.samplingStep2: Packaging: Place in an airtight, clean double-seal ziplock pouch. For fermented silage, squeeze out excess air to prevent post-sampling aerobic spoilage.
lab.samplingStep3: Labeling: Clearly label with Sample ID, Date Collected, Farm Location, and Suspected Condition (e.g. Mold / Urea Adulteration).
lab.footer: DAHD / ICAR / NDDB Accredited Laboratory Referral
